alerts_topic_arn.description: SNS topic for alarms and the budget.

invocation_logs_bucket_name.description: Bucket that receives Bedrock model invocation logs.

kms_key_arn.description: KMS key for the policy documents, invocation logs and alerts topic.

policies_bucket_arn.description: ARN of the policy document bucket.

policies_bucket_name.description: Bucket the knowledge base ingests. Upload policy documents and their .metadata.json files here.

enable_invocation_logging.description: Turn on Bedrock model invocation logging for the account and Region (an account-level setting).

force_destroy.description: Allow destroying buckets that still hold objects. Only the live test sets this.

log_retention_days.description: Days to keep invocation logs and S3 access logs.

name.description: Name prefix for every resource (lower case, digits and hyphens).

noncurrent_version_days.description: Days to keep previous versions of policy documents and log objects.

region.description: AWS Region for every stack in this repository.

after.description: harbor-policy-assistant: policy documents, invocation logs, alerts
